correctness.rationale: For n>=4, specify an n-cycle as a permutation with one group-theoretic cycle and use non-wrapping triples of values at positions i,i+1,i+2. An injective prescribed three-edge partial map extends to an n-cycle iff it is acyclic, then uniquely by cyclically arranging n-3 path components in (n-4)! ways. Removing the only possible partial directed cycles (loops, 2-cycles, 3-cycles) by inclusion-exclusion yields the six explicit integer Q_tau(i,n) polynomials; summing i and dividing by (n-1)(n-2)(n-3) gives zero shift for 123/321, -1/[2(n-1)] for 132/213 and +1/[2(n-1)] for 231/312. Multiplying shifts by P(one n-cycle)=1/n gives the indicated covariance. Direct independent enumeration of n-cycles at n=4..8 gave 30 exact rational mean checks; source verify_cycles.py and symbolic derive_table.py were read, and their algorithms agree with the proof. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove all n.

value.rationale: The uniform n-cycle is a canonical random permutation class; consecutive 3-patterns are the smallest complete local order-sensitive motifs beyond descents. The exact all-n six-way bias and paired cancellation reveal subtle global-to-local dependence not visible under the unrestricted uniform measure, with natural applications to cycle-conditioned local-pattern statistics, even though the shifts vanish asymptotically.
